mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDERNO AS orderNo, p.NAME AS productName, p.IMG1 AS productImg, oi.PRICE AS price, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, (oi.PRICE * oi.QUANTITY) AS totalPrice, o.STATUS AS status, o.ORDEREDAT AS orderedAt, s.MEMID AS sellerId, ms.COMPANY AS sellerName, s.ADDRESSBASIC AS sellerAddress FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM oi ON o.ORDERNO = oi.ORDERNO JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON oi.PROID = p.PROID JOIN TB_MEMBER s ON p.MEMID = s.MEMID JOIN TB_MEMBER_SELLER ms ON s.MEMID = ms.MEMID WHERE o.MEMID = #{memId} ORDER BY o.ORDEREDAT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
